runegrafts.description: Link Skills have 50% increased range
Arcane Surge also grants 15% increased Life Regeneration Rate to you
Spells have Added Spell Damage equal to 30% of Physical Damage of your Equipped Two Handed Weapon
Nova Spells Cast at a Marked target instead of around you if possible
Spells Cost +8% of Life; Spells deal added Chaos Damage equal to 2% of your maximum Life
40% chance for Elemental Ailments inflicted on you to be inflicted on a nearby Minion instead
Auras from your Skills which affect Allies also affect Enemies; 15% increased Reservation Efficiency of Skills
20% chance for Skills to not consume a Cooldown on use
30% chance to Curse non-Cursed Enemies with a random Hex on Hit
Debuffs on you expire 30% faster; Buffs on you expire 30% slower
10% reduced Attributes; 40% increased Global Defences
+1 to Level of all non-Exceptional Support Gems
10% more Attack Speed with Off Hand
20% increased bonuses gained from Equipped Gloves; 20% reduced bonuses gained from Equipped Boots
Fire at most 1 Projectile; Projectiles Fork; Projectiles Chain an additional time
Tinctures applied to you have 30% increased Effect while affected by no Flasks
Elusive's Effect on you is increased instead for the first 2 seconds
50% increased Damage with Damaging Ailments you inflict while you are affected by the same Ailment
Non-instant Mana Recovery from Flasks is also Recovered as Life; 25% reduced Mana Recovery from Flasks
Enemies Poisoned by you have 10% of Physical Damage they deal converted to Chaos
10% reduced Attributes; 40% increased Global Defences
+1 to Level of all non-Exceptional Support Gems
20% chance on reaching Low Life to recover to Full Life
50% increased Attack Damage against Enemies with a higher percentage of their Life remaining than you
Gain 1 Vaal Soul per second
40% of Damage taken from Critical Strikes Recouped as Life
100% increased Warcry Speed if you have not Warcried Recently
10% increased Damage for each unlinked Socket in Equipped Two Handed Weapon
Your Lucky or Unlucky effects are instead Unexciting
Consecrated Ground you create grants 30% increased Mana Regeneration Rate to you and Allies
Gain 3 Rage when you use a Life Flask
Gain 1 Fortification per 5 Valour consumed to place a Banner
10% reduced Attributes; 40% increased Global Defences
+1 to Level of all non-Exceptional Support Gems
